mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates central bank stimulus amid inflation, which typically leads to positive equity returns as growth expectations rise over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP growth regime (GDPC1 above 3.0% annualized), robust economic expansion supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side economic activity that supports corporate output and profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800 thousand units signals weak residential demand, reducing economic activity and corporate revenues, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 1800, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 133000 thousand, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
